## Equations
### EQ001 — Potts-like minimum vertex graph coloring objective

*Defines the business problem: reward assigned colors and penalize equal colors on adjacent vertices.*

$$
H_P\simeq-A\sum_{v\in V}\sum_{i=1}^{k} n_i^{(v)}+B\sum_{(u,v)\in E}\sum_{i=1}^{k}n_i^{(u)}n_i^{(v)}
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equation: Eq. (2), Sec. 3.5

Numerical form:

```
Use integer local states as colors; validate every decoded assignment by checking color[u] != color[v] for each graph edge.
```

Code: `code/src/rydberg_qudit.py:proper_coloring_indices`, `code/src/rydberg_qudit.py:paper_figure_target_indices`


### EQ002 — Multilevel Rydberg-qudit Hamiltonian

*Maps atom coordinates and one Omega/Delta/Phi channel per Rydberg level to the simulated many-body dynamics.*

$$
H_{Ryd}=\sum_{v,i}[\Omega_i(t)\sigma_i^{(v)}/2-\Delta_i(t)n_i^{(v)}]+\sum_{u<v,i}V^{(i)}(R_{uv})n_i^{(u)}n_i^{(v)}+\sum_{u<v,i<j}V^{(ij)}(R_{uv})[n_i^{(u)}n_j^{(v)}+n_j^{(u)}n_i^{(v)}]
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001` · source: paper_equation: Eq. (3), Sec. 4.1; paper_appendix: Appendix A.1-A.2 C6, Omega and Delta tables

Numerical form:

```
Enumerate the local basis |g>,|r1>,...,|rk>; precompute pairwise diagonal C6/R^6 energies and sparse |g><->|ri> drive matrices.
```

### EQ003 — Encoding interval under finite negative inter-level interactions

*Defines when physical spacing and detuning preserve the intended graph-coloring ground-state ordering.*

$$
|V^{(ij)}(a)|<\Delta_i<|V^{(i)}(a)+(\alpha-1)V_{max}^{(ij)}(a)|
$$

### EQ004 — Normalized annealing schedules and time propagation

*Provides the five-knot Omega/Delta/Phi handoff and the 8.4 us numerical execution path.*

$$
\Delta_i(t)=\Delta_i^{max}\tilde\delta(t),\quad\Omega_i(t)=\Omega_i^{max}\tilde\omega(t);\quad\tilde\delta=(-1,8(t-t_0)^3/\tau^3,1),\quad\tilde\omega=(t/t_i,1,(T-t)/(T-t_f))
$$
